scope: Sunnyvale (S Sunnyvale Ave), Santa Clara (El Camino Real), Los Gatos (W Main St, Union Ave)
method: Each row resolved to one street address and a per-day hours block from at least two independent dated captures; First Born is confirmed on its own website. Prices appear in the price columns only where a published menu or a business-owned page printed them.

flags: The split personality is the finding: lunch exists Thu-Sun (11:30 AM) but not Tue-Wed (4:30 PM open), so a Tuesday lunch plan must skip it even though it is 'open'. The only printed discount is a happy-hour drink deal, and its Thu-Sun 2:00-5:30 PM window overlaps the restaurant's own 11:30 AM lunch open - an inconsistency worth a call.
